headline: Hot October CPI and hawkish Fed talk pushed the 10-yr near 5% and the dollar up, weighing on tech.
brief: The Nasdaq Composite fell 0.74% to 25,066 and QQQ lost 0.68%, closing mid-range after a hotter-than-expected October CPI and a 5.5% drop in Nvidia. The 10-yr rose about 10 bp to 4.98% and the dollar firmed against the euro and yen, while Waller and Logan both signaled support for further rate hikes; VIX eased to about 19.5. Asia-session catalysts look light tonight; the key risk is further repricing of Fed hike odds and CoreWeave's after-hours results.

sources.title: CNBC things to watch after CPI
